title: AV: named rollback checks preserve business records or safely refuse
public_pr_body:
Adds named real-database tests for packaged releases 138, 144, 145 and 146 in the existing ordered post-144 proof file. Each creates fake company/customer/invoice positive controls, snapshots business tables, attempts the reviewed rollback inside an outer transaction and checks retained rows exactly. Only documented P0001 safety refusals are accepted, with unchanged snapshots; other errors fail. Every test restores its outer transaction.

Assumptions: feature-owned data intentionally removed by 138 (chase/claim fields) and 145 (setup ticks) is NOT called retained. Claim metadata is excluded from the business-row comparison because 138 deliberately removes its columns. These tests are not a claim that those rollbacks preserve all data or a substitute for backup/export proof. 140-143 have no files on this candidate. Tests stay in the sequencer's existing post-release file, so no baseline ordering or catalogue checks are weakened.

TypeScript and changed-file ESLint passed; diff check passed. Real SQL tests NOT RUN under the explicit no-SQL rule; separately authorised disposable rehearsal required. No release applied, Ready label, merge, deployment, credentials or docs/ files.
